citation.source: 7 CFR 210.10(c)(2)(iii) vegetable subgroups (potatoes are the canonical starchy-vegetable example across USDA/state crediting guides) plus the general as-served-volume crediting rule for cooked/raw vegetables: 1 cup served credits as 1 cup eq (no 2:1 reduction — that applies only to raw leafy greens, which potato is not).
citation.note: The starchy subgroup has its own weekly minimum, separate from 'other' — see 7 CFR 210.10's Chart 1B weekly minimums.
